---
title: "Box Office Numbers"
---

This website analyzes a dataset of 104 films from 1980 to 2025. The dataset includes film titles, release years, franchises, approximate budgets and worldwide revenues in millions of dollars, runtimes, and IMDb ratings.

The analysis explores the relationship between budget and revenue, runtime and ratings, and the revenue history of James Bond films.

- [Budget and Revenue](budget-revenue.qmd)
- [Runtime and Ratings](runtime-rating.qmd)
- [The Bond Films](bond.qmd)

AI tools used during this quiz: ChatGPT. I used ChatGPT for help with troubleshooting, understanding Git and Quarto commands, and guidance on the Python analysis and website setup. I reviewed, wrote, and ran all code and commands myself.
